changeSet.author: grushton

preConditions.onFailMessage: dar_dataset_daa_snapshot must have 1 timestamp or timestamptz column(s): captured_at. Compare the deployed schema with the changesets before you deploy.
preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = current_schema() AND table_name = 'dar_dataset_daa_snapshot' AND column_name IN ('captured_at') AND data_type IN ('timestamp without time zone', 'timestamp with time zone')

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE dar_dataset_daa_snapshot ALTER COLUMN captured_at TYPE timestamp with time zone

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE dar_dataset_daa_snapshot ALTER COLUMN captured_at TYPE timestamp without time zone
